:::{#def-quadratic-program}
#### Quadratic program (quadratic programming problem)

A **quadratic program**, or **quadratic programming problem**,
[@wikipedia_quadratic_programming]
is a [minimization problem](#def-minimization-problem) whose objective is

$$f(\vx) = \tfrac{1}{2}\,\qform{\matr{S}}{\vx} + \tp{\vecf{c}} \vx,$$

for a $p \times p$ [positive semidefinite](linear-algebra.qmd#def-positive-semidefinite) matrix $\matr{S}$ and a vector $\vecf{c} \in \reals^p$,
and whose [constraints](#def-constraints) are linear equations and linear inequalities in $\vx$.

:::
